findings.evidence: Body is `Module.compHom L (algebraMap ℚ K)` + `lie_smul`, needing only `Algebra ℚ K`. Mathlib/Algebra/Algebra/Rat.lean:58 `instance DivisionRing.toRatAlgebra : Algebra ℚ R` is the only route `Field`+`CharZero` uses. Mathlib/Algebra/Lie/Derivation/Basic.lean:400 states `LieDerivation.exp` for `[CommRing R] ... [LieAlgebra ℚ L]`.
findings.fix: State it as `def ratLieAlgebra (K L) [CommRing K] [Algebra ℚ K] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra K L] : LieAlgebra ℚ L` with the same body; `exists_lieEquiv_forall_mem_rootSpace` still gets it since `Field K` + `CharZero K` yields `Algebra ℚ K`.
findings.issue: `ratLieAlgebra` assumes `[Field K] [CharZero K]`, but the body only needs the ring hom `algebraMap ℚ K`; the field/char-zero pair is stronger than the proof and than the base ring `LieDerivation.exp` and the rest of this file work over (`[CommRing K]`).

findings.evidence: `(-h,-f,-e)` is a triple: `⁅-f,-e⁆ = ⁅f,e⁆ = -h`, `⁅-h,-f⁆ = ⁅h,f⁆ = 2•(-f)`, `⁅-h,-e⁆ = ⁅h,e⁆ = -(2•(-e))`. Mathlib/Algebra/Lie/Sl2.lean:52 has `symm`; the repo already uses this idiom in TauCeti/Algebra/Lie/Sl2/Casimir.lean:166 (`lie_f_sl2Casimir` from `lie_e_sl2Casimir t.symm`).
findings.fix: Add `IsSl2Triple.neg : IsSl2Triple h e f → IsSl2Triple h (-e) (-f)` (three `rw`s), then derive both from the `e`-versions applied to `t.symm.neg : IsSl2Triple (-h) (-f) (-e)` plus `map_neg`/`neg_inj`.
findings.issue: `expAd_neg_f_apply_h` (line 127) and `expAd_neg_f_apply_e` (line 138) duplicate the computations of `expAd_e_apply_h` (line 111) and `expAd_e_apply_f` (line 117) — same truncation lemma, same `2 • x` cast juggling — instead of instantiating them at the triple obtained by negating.

summary: The bracket-level API sits at the right level and the Killing-section hypotheses are all used, but `ratLieAlgebra` is restricted to fields where a ℚ-algebra base suffices, and the two `exp (ad (-f))` computations re-prove the `exp (ad e)` ones instead of instantiating them at the negated triple.
